policies.recommended: Resolve role-bearing tokens through immutable owner-reviewed catalogs; scope inclusion uses the owned relation and preserves all ancestor restrictions. Unresolved provenance remains unknown.
policies.alternative: Provide a different explicit owner resolution/inclusion policy before its affected definitions can be accepted.
policies.consequence: Neither a role label nor a scope token authenticates a grant or owner.
policies.proposed_choice: Resolve role-bearing tokens through immutable owner-reviewed catalogs; scope inclusion uses the owned relation and preserves all ancestor restrictions. Unresolved provenance remains unknown.

policies.recommended: Support both exact epoch intervals and owner-resolved session windows. Finite intervals use start <= epoch < stop; a session window uses the exact session's independently observed active period in one time domain.
policies.alternative: Choose interval-only meaning and supply an exact lawful session-to-interval mapping for every session-period source; omitted session cases remain unfinished.
policies.consequence: Legacy session-valued effective_period strings are not parsed as dates or silently rejected as a narrower finished profile.
policies.proposed_choice: Support both exact epoch intervals and owner-resolved session windows. Finite intervals use start <= epoch < stop; a session window uses the exact session's independently observed active period in one time domain.

policies.recommended: Retain all independently active norm origins. Opposing active requirements produce an explicit conflict state; no permission/fulfillment is issued until an exact reviewed resolution policy applies. Lesson precedence resolves an owned policy with override evidence.
policies.alternative: Specify and review an explicit priority/override policy, then prove its ordering and scope before using it.
policies.consequence: The AST's positive rail activates a norm but cannot select a winner or grant authority.
policies.proposed_choice: Retain all independently active norm origins. Opposing active requirements produce an explicit conflict state; no permission/fulfillment is issued until an exact reviewed resolution policy applies. Lesson precedence resolves an owned policy with override evidence.

policies.recommended: Use relation-specific owned code catalogs and endpoint-pair interpretations. Preserve proposed, attempted, completed, rejected, failed, applied and deliberately-not-used as distinct postures; claim actual observation/use/production only with its exact witness.
policies.alternative: Supply different explicit role/posture domains and source mappings for affected kinds.
policies.consequence: Identical code spelling in two kinds does not identify the same role or outcome.
policies.proposed_choice: Use relation-specific owned code catalogs and endpoint-pair interpretations. Preserve proposed, attempted, completed, rejected, failed, applied and deliberately-not-used as distinct postures; claim actual observation/use/production only with its exact witness.

policies.recommended: Preserve the legacy any-exact-accepted-positive-support profile unchanged. Use a separately versioned successor fulfillment policy: an admissible exact negative assessment refutes its criterion; negative evidence from an unaccepted action/output is inadmissible; opposing admissible positive and negative assessments produce conflict; missing admissible support remains unknown.
policies.alternative: Choose a separately versioned quorum, issuer hierarchy or alternative negative-admissibility policy, then prove it without relabeling existing any-support evidence.
policies.consequence: Conflict is a diagnostic state outside the yes/no/unknown truth value; it is never permission.
policies.proposed_choice: Preserve the legacy any-exact-accepted-positive-support profile unchanged. Use a separately versioned successor fulfillment policy: an admissible exact negative assessment refutes its criterion; negative evidence from an unaccepted action/output is inadmissible; opposing admissible positive and negative assessments produce conflict; missing admissible support remains unknown.

policies.topic: Criterion completeness and Context Request fulfillment
policies.recommended: Require the exact owned complete criterion set. Context Request criteria cover selectors, exclusions, freshness at resolution, budget and output constraints; intended fulfillment without completed support cannot count as fulfilled. Canonical criterion order is retained in the first successor contract.
policies.alternative: Propose an explicit different interpretation of fulfillment or order policy for review; a smaller caller-selected set cannot close the original completeness claim.
policies.consequence: The generic E03 model needs an explicit Context Request/View source bridge.
policies.proposed_choice: Require the exact owned complete criterion set. Context Request criteria cover selectors, exclusions, freshness at resolution, budget and output constraints; intended fulfillment without completed support cannot count as fulfilled. Canonical criterion order is retained in the first successor contract.

policies.recommended: Label each claim recorded, checked as-of, locally executed or externally observed. Exact receipts and source adapters establish their named provenance. Historical fulfillment/conformance does not establish later live currentness.
policies.alternative: Provide the stronger authenticated source and clock model required for a chosen live/external claim.
policies.consequence: Fake fixture approval, observed bytes or a success label cannot become actual owner or execution evidence.
policies.proposed_choice: Label each claim recorded, checked as-of, locally executed or externally observed. Exact receipts and source adapters establish their named provenance. Historical fulfillment/conformance does not establish later live currentness.

policies.recommended: Review every kind-scoped conclusion as a distinct typed proposition. Prove non-entailment with a valid antecedent and absent/false conclusion. Also prove full-rule closure/state preservation for authority, identity and ownership boundaries where required. Materialization consumes prior authorization; supersession additionally requires supersedes and qualified replacement.
policies.alternative: Identify a different exact intended conclusion or legitimate extra inference rule; re-formalize its affected theory and preservation obligations before acceptance.
policies.consequence: A valid relation can coexist with an independently established conclusion; exclusions do not mean the conclusion is always false.
policies.proposed_choice: Review every kind-scoped conclusion as a distinct typed proposition. Prove non-entailment with a valid antecedent and absent/false conclusion. Also prove full-rule closure/state preservation for authority, identity and ownership boundaries where required. Materialization consumes prior authorization; supersession additionally requires supersedes and qualified replacement.
